description: Inbound messages correctly inserted into ConversationThreads. For any valid message_received notification, exactly one ConversationMessage is created with role 'user', correct author attribution, and channelId set to the Reticulum channel.

preconditions.description: A valid message_received notification is received from the sidecar

expectedOutcome.description: A ConversationMessage is inserted with role 'user', author from source_name or destination hash, and channelId 'reticulum-mesh-channel'
